titles.title: SUCCESS Act of 2026
SUCCESS Act of 2026
Support for Universities and Colleges to Champion the Educational Success of Survivors Act of 2026
A bill to establish a grant program for institutions of higher education to implement patient-centered academic counseling services for student survivors of sexual assault and other violence.

action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions.
